newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-News appoints new Australian editor.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-News appoints new Australian editor.

text.p: News Ltd, the Australian offshoot of international media group, The News Corp Ltd, said it had appointed David Armstrong as editor-in-chief of The Australian national newspaper, replacing Paul Kelly who would take up the new position of international editor.
The changes would take effect next Monday, News Ltd chairman Ken Cowley said.
Armstrong, 49, was editor-in-chief of the South China Morning Post newspaper between 1993, when News Corp controlled that newspaper, and 1996.
